### Assignment / Tutorial Record {.unnumbered}

The table below is read live from the `Register` sheet (assignment/tutorial grade columns) of the workbook.

```{r}
#| label: assignment-tutorial-record
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| results: asis

library(readxl)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

source(file.path(dirname(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)), "_data_helpers.R"))

register_df <- read_workbook_sheet(cf_sheet("register"))

if (is.null(register_df)) {
	notify_workbook_missing()
} else {
	register_df <- as.data.frame(register_df)
	render_register_table(
		register_df,
		keys = c("serial_no", "student_name", "assignment_1", "assignment_2", "assignment_3", "assignment_4", "assignment_5", "assignment_total"),
		labels = c("S. No.", "Student Name", "Assign. 1", "Assign. 2", "Assign. 3", "Assign. 4", "Assign. 5", "Total"),
		col_widths = c("0.35in", "2.30in"),
		font_size = 8,
		tight = TRUE
	)
}
```
